body: - **Step 5 (self-review)**: `_pin_architectural_guidelines_note_best_effort` (python/larch/state/closeout.py:224, now carrying the #6021 refresh-retry fix) is invoked only from `step_16_17`. The terminal-unrecoverable-stall closeout path (`python/larch/report/final_report.py:918-919` `step18b_final_report` → `closeout.step_16_16a`, used per `skills/implement/scripts/step-18.md` when a run never reaches Step 16/17 through the normal sequence) never calls the pin helper at all, so the architectural-guidelines note is dropped unconditionally on that path — not just on fingerprint drift. This predates #6021 and is a distinct gap (whether the pin is *attempted* at all) from the one #6021 fixes (whether the *refresh-retry* inside the pin helper works). Filed as OOS rather than folded inline because it requires design judgment about whether/how to add the call to `step_16_16a` without risking a double-pin attempt if the run later also reaches `step_16_17`, which is beyond the vetted #6021 plan scope.
- **Step 5**: self-review mode: main-agent inline review complete.
